title: Navigation cost after the split has a verdict
goal: kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv holds three runs of the navigation scenario, arm after, at the post-split commit, and benchmarks.md compares them with the baseline and ends the section with a Verdict line: split further, or stop splitting
